source_specs.license_note: Pinned HF card marks data license unknown. Official model-code repository has Apache2.0; it is not asserted to license this externally hosted dataset.
Official Google dataset README and pinned HF card both state CC-BY-SA3.0.

selection.ranking: Ascending SHA256(UTF8(decimal_seed + verticalbar + source_key + verticalbar + source_id)); tie break source_id. Seed20261104. No tokenizer/model/answer-based selection.
selection.openbookqa_source_id: Publisher id string; duplicates or empty ids fail integrity checks.
selection.boolq_source_id: Canonical decimal zero-based pinned validation Parquet row index; HFschema has no publisher id field. It is a source-row id, not a claimed original Google id.
selection.openbookqa_eligibility: Nonempty string question_stem; exactly4nonempty string choices with4distinct nonempty labels. No length truncation or answerKey inspection.
selection.boolq_eligibility: Nonempty string passage and question. Full text preserved; no length, difficulty, answer or model-based filter.
selection.openbookqa_render: question_stem.strip()+LF+source-order label.strip()+dot+space+choice_text.strip(), LF-separated, final LF. No facts, answer or answer cue added.
selection.boolq_render: Literal Passage: +LF+passage.strip()+LF+LF+literal Question: +LF+question.strip()+LF. No answer or answer cue added.
selection.item_order: OpenBookQA ranks00..07, then BoolQ ranks00..07, same16prompt bytes supplied to both G4andDeep.
selection.failures: Fewer than8eligible, duplicate ids, duplicate selected prompts or invalid selected answers fail; do not relax/resample.
selection.answers: Read answer columns only after chosen row indices are fixed. Store labels/booleans in answers/answers.json; never append them to prompts.

bindings.checkpoint_hash_provenance: Exact existing model hashes inherited from the independently frozen numerical protocols. No model is downloaded or rehashed in acquisition; numeric runners own model verification.
bindings.dataset_revision_note: Dataset HFcommit revisions are separately pinned in acquisition protocol; they are not model checkpoint revisions.

workload_contract.input_policy: Complete question/options and complete BoolQpassage/question; no128token truncation. Record actual model-tokenized lengths. No chat template in stored prompt bytes.
workload_contract.placement: Frozen W8train-compiled plans unchanged; no placement/weight/scale calibration fit after target payload.
workload_contract.quality: A16token free generation is not a benchmark accuracy estimate. Runner freezes and records any teacher-forcing/scoring contract separately before inference.
workload_contract.provenance: Dataset commits are not checkpoint commits. Fresh within-project source formats do not establish model-pretraining decontamination or a representative full benchmark.

preprotocol_exposure: Official repository README schema examples were viewed; their membership in a target split was not tested. AI2homepage redirected to HFlanding, which may carry automatic previews. No target Parquet/JSONL/footer/viewer-rows endpoint was fetched, and no example is used for ranking or eligibility.
